subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella for both structured Control UI reply metadata and no-output/final fallback semantics, or should maintainers split it across the narrower active items now?
rationale: Current main has only a Markdown UI reply affordance, while the remaining work crosses protocol, session/runtime context, and final delivery semantics; automation should not choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Keep the umbrella until contracts land
options.body: Leave this issue open until the reply metadata path is resolved through active PR work and the no-output half is explicitly handed to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

options.title: Split now to canonical items
options.body: Close this issue only after linking the reply metadata half to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88032 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 and the fallback half to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

options.title: Accept Markdown-only reply UX
options.body: Treat the merged Control UI quote feature as sufficient and explicitly reject structured webchat reply metadata for now.

recommendation.title: Keep the umbrella until contracts land
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until the reply metadata path is resolved through active PR work and the no-output half is explicitly handed to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans gateway protocol, Control UI, session runtime context, and product fallback behavior rather than one contributor patch.
